source: Seller Central Payments balance API (LIVE): GET /payments/api/balances/Total + /payments/api/balances/AvailableNow, read from the Mac Mini Chrome session (residential IP). No SP-API (no balance endpoint exists); no estimate.
bucket_mapping: Buckets keyed by marketplaceName (Standard Orders / Invoiced Orders / Deferred Transactions). NOTE: both Invoiced AND Deferred carry accountType=INVOICING — do NOT map by accountType, use marketplaceName.
precision_note: amount.amount is already major USD units (e.g. 56034.21 = $56,034.21). Do NOT divide by currencyPrecision.
stale_rule: Surfaces flag STALE when as_of is older than 24h. The last good values are held until a fresh read succeeds; a wrong/blank number is never written as if live.
fallback: When stale, surfaces additionally show ap/data.json.held.net labeled 'API estimate — lags ~48h, not Seller Central; cannot split Standard vs Invoiced'. Never the headline, never feeds cash-impact.

cash_impact.uses: all_total (live SC) when fresh; last-good SC reading (stamped with age) when stale; NEVER the API assembly

refresh: A twice-daily scheduled Mac Mini Chrome read recommits this file from the live SC balance API. Fail-closed: on session expiry it does NOT overwrite (page auto-goes STALE) and alerts Ekene to log in once.
one_time_setup: Ekene logs into Seller Central once in the Mac Mini's Chrome with 'Keep me signed in' + trust the device. Re-auth needed ~every 1-2 weeks when Amazon expires the session (alert fires).
